sources.title: DeepSeek R1 0528 Qwen3 8B (8B) | Deploy Guide & Hardware Fit | OpenModelMap
sources.snippet: DeepSeek-R1-0528 is a reinforcement learning-optimized model based on the Qwen3-8B architecture, focusing on enhancing reasoning capabilities. It improves logical reasoning and mathematical problem-solving through techniques like RLHF while maintaining strong Chinese support, making it suitable for complex tasks requiring high-accuracy reasoning.

sources.title: Run DeepSeek-R1-0528 Locally: Hardware + Ollama, vLLM
sources.snippet: DeepSeek-R1-0528-Qwen3-8B is a distilled version — a much smaller model trained to mimic the full model's reasoning behavior. The 8B model is practical on consumer hardware; the full model requires a small cluster or a Mac with 400+ GB unified memory.
